description: This file defines the ServerRequest class which extends the Request class to implement server-side HTTP request handling according to PSR-7 standards. It adds methods for accessing server parameters, cookies, uploaded files, URI, query parameters, and request attributes. It also includes static methods for creating instances from PHP global variables and for normalizing uploaded files.

classes.name: ServerRequest
classes.description: Represents an immutable HTTP server-side request message, extending Request with methods to access server parameters, uploaded files, cookies, query and attribute data.

methods.name: normalizeFiles
methods.description: Normalizes an array of uploaded files to ensure all entries are instances of UploadedFileInterface, handling nested structures and array uploads.

methods.name: createUploadedFileFromSpec
methods.description: Creates an UploadedFile instance from a $_FILES style array specification.

methods.name: normalizeNestedFileSpec
methods.description: Normalizes nested file specifications into individual UploadedFileInterface instances.

methods.name: fromGlobals
methods.description: Creates a ServerRequest object populated with data from PHP superglobals ($_SERVER, $_GET, $_POST, $_COOKIE, $_FILES).

methods.name: getUriFromGlobals
methods.description: Constructs a Uri object based on the PHP superglobals, reflecting the current request URI.
